[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, registered here under the legacy name San Antonio I, sits at Vantages Texas Research Park campus in Bexar County, Texas, near the crossing of Omicron Drive and Theta Drive. Local press (San Antonio Report, August 31, 2023, tier-4 source, https://sanantonioreport.org/san-antonio-vantage-data-centers-microsoft-west-side/) reported Vantage purchased 57.9 acres at this Texas Research Park location in late July 2023, beside the Omicron and Theta crossing, distinct from a separate 31 acre Vantage parcel the company also bought that August at the Highway 151 and Wiseman Boulevard crossing in Westover Hills, which this registry tracks separately as the TX21 and TX22 rows. Coordinates for this row place it within about 150 meters of the registrys TX11 and TX12 rows, consistent with all three sharing the Texas Research Park campus, though the exact correspondence between the legacy San Antonio I name and the operators current TX-numbered building designations is not confirmed by the operator itself. No specific street number or MW figure distinct from TX11 or TX12 was found for this specific legacy-named row this session. A prior note on this row associated it with Frontier, a Vantage mega-campus announced August 2025. This is corrected here, Vantages own August 2025 press release (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/news/vantage-data-centers-unveils-plans-for-frontier-a-25b-mega-campus-in-texas-to-meet-unprecedented-ai-demand/) states Frontier is a 1,200 acre, 1.4 GW, 25 billion dollar, ten building campus in Shackelford County, Texas, near Albany, roughly 300 miles from San Antonio and Bexar County. Frontier is not the San Antonio area campus this row belongs to, it is a separate, later, and much larger project elsewhere in Texas.
